title: Record Korean phrases
brief: A speech research team needs a natural reading of three Korean prompts.
steps: Record the three short phrases in a quiet room.
Listen back and confirm that this is your own voice.
Submit to the test buyer for review.
usage: Voice quality evaluation in this local demonstration. Audio stays on this server.

title: Compare AI answers
brief: Select the clearer answer to a customer billing question and explain why.
steps: Read the question and two candidate answers.
Select an answer and write a short reason.
Submit your evaluation to the test buyer.

title: Check receipt totals
brief: A labeling team needs a human to check a receipt extracted by OCR.
steps: Submit the corrected total for review.

title: License a photo
brief: Prepare one original still-life photo for the test licensing catalog. Payment depends on a sale.
steps: Describe it and confirm permission to license it.
Submit the listing. The buyer may purchase it later.

title: Review an interview transcript
brief: An extended review of an English transcript.
